name: Longest Bridge Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Build A Bridge

How to play:
🔨 Smash blocks with your hammer!
🏆 Build a bridge with your blocks to get wins!
🐶 Hatch pets for huge bonuses!

👥 Invite friends for a huge boost! 
🎁 Join the group for in-game rewards!
⌛ Premium players get +20% speed and +10% luck!

A TBlox Studios Mini Project!
